name: Meridian Plaza
description: A sun-drenched downtown plaza sealed off for sanctioned arena combat: shattered storefronts, a flooded fountain channel, and structural pillars that will not survive the afternoon.

disclosures: Open sky and full daylight: solar-powered fighters recharge at accelerated rates.
Four destructible structural pillars and two wrecks provide ranged cover (25% ranged damage reduction near intact cover) until destroyed.
Central flooded channel: ground fighters without aquatic affinity move 35% slower inside it; hydrokinetic abilities gain access to water-context abilities near it.
Large metal structures throughout: magnetic abilities are usable here.
No movement restrictions or visibility conditions at match start.
Wildcards may be placed anywhere within the arena bounds.
Known synergy: solar and light-based kits benefit from the daylight tags.
Known disadvantage: slow ground-only fighters can be kited in the long east–west sightlines.
